prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one square generic feminine writer avatar for a literary journal, explicitly an anonymous placeholder rather than a likeness of any real person. Input reference is ONLY watercolor medium and warm ivory paper reference; DO NOT copy the man's face, hair, clothing or identity. Subject: simple abstract feminine head-and-shoulders silhouette, softly suggested shoulder-length hair, face entirely featureless and unpainted ivory negative space, no eyes, nose, mouth, jewelry, bindi, skin color or age markers. Muted deep teal hair silhouette and loose teal/ochre shoulder washes taper into ivory cotton paper. Human Natural / Poetic Natural: gentle uneven hand-painted contour, selective restrained graphite edges, quiet asymmetry, lots of blank paper, small irregular ochre wash on one side only; no symmetrical decorative halo, no fake dirt, no excessive grain or microtexture. Clearly a generic illustrated avatar at both 64px circular thumbnail size and 600px profile size, not a realistic unknown woman's portrait. Head and shoulders fit central 70 percent with ample headroom for circular crop. No text, symbols, pen props, logo or signature.
review: Faceless ivory negative space, abstract teal hair and shoulder washes. No facial features, skin tone, age, bindi or jewelry invented. At normal viewing size clearly a shared generic avatar; no source likeness asserted.
